rationales.LC: Default PluginBot is an unauthenticated MCP JSON-RPC tool server, and no model is called unless LLM mode is switched on. The register_tool path is a structured tools/call, not attacker natural language reaching a model decision or tool-selection sink.
rationales.CP: register_tool is advertised afterward in tools/list, so the name outlives the registering call, but the packet only documents durable cross-request memory for MemoryBot and does not say whether the PluginBot registry is session-scoped, in-process only, or durable.
rationales.AP: The implemented effect is a lookalike entry in PluginBot's own advertised registry with no new handler. No code sends that registration to another agent, tenant, or policy domain.
rationales.RH: The in-repo check is a curl success-path test of registration, not a human-verified episode of an agent reaching a grader, reward, or monitor. Nothing shows whether any evaluator on this path is reachable or isolated.
rationales.ES: PluginBot accepts runtime tool definitions with no signature, source, or name-similarity check, so advertised tool identity is dynamic and unconstrained even though a registered name gets no new handler.

score.automatable_rationale: The documented solution is an unauthenticated curl tools/call to register_tool. No human prompt, approval, or per-target decision is required to add the lookalike registry entry.
score.technical_impact_rationale: Default impact is a limited change to PluginBot's advertised tool list (add or replace, cap 16) with no new handler, no data disclosure, and no execution in place of the legitimate tool.

applicability_as_implemented.rationale: In the default simulated configuration no model is called, and PluginBot is an MCP server whose tools run only when a caller invokes them directly.

applicability_as_modeled.rationale: The lab models PluginBot as an unverified MCP registry and a later external agent or user as the one who might mistype a name; it does not model PluginBot as pursuing a goal or sequencing that call.
